caseNameFull: Amerex Holding Corporation v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Bertram F. Shipman for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key, Richard H. Demuth, and Arthur A. Armstrong for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
